project.name: oxiguitar-coreaudio
project.description: macOS Core Audio output plugin for OxiGuitar.

nodes.name: CI
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow running formatting checks, linting (Clippy + docs on MSRV), tests on six platforms (Linux x86_64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86_64, Windows ARM64, macOS), licence/advisory checks via cargo-deny, and DCO sign-off validation on pull requests. A ci-success gate ensures all jobs pass before merging.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formatting job that runs cargo fmt --all --check on the stable Rust toolchain. Depends on the rust job which gates on Cargo.toml existence.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.summary: Linting job that runs Clippy and doc builds on the MSRV (Rust 1.99) to ensure CI and contributor machines agree. Treats all warnings as errors. Installs APT packages when needed.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: Test job running on a matrix of six platforms (Linux x86_64, Linux ARM64, Windows x86_64, Windows ARM64, macOS, plus MSRV). Runs cargo test and the Features page check via scripts/test-all.py --features-only.

nodes.name: deny
nodes.summary: Licence and advisory check job using EmbarkStudios/cargo-deny-action with --all-features. Verifies dependency licenses and security advisories.

nodes.name: dco
nodes.summary: DCO sign-off validation job that runs scripts/check-dco.sh between the PR base and head SHAs. Only runs on pull requests.

nodes.name: ci-success
nodes.summary: Gate job that passes only if every other CI job passed or was skipped. Checks that no job has failure or cancelled status.

nodes.name: Manual
nodes.summary: Builds and publishes the mdBook manual (docs/manual/) to GitHub Pages. On PRs it builds and checks for broken links; on pushes to main it publishes to https://mateusrdp.github.io/oxiguitar-coreaudio/. Downloads and verifies mdBook v0.5.4 by SHA-256.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Builds the manual with mdBook, fails on warnings or errors, and checks internal links for missing pages. Uploads the built book as a GitHub Pages artifact.

nodes.name: deploy
nodes.summary: Publishes the built manual to GitHub Pages using actions/deploy-pages@v5. Only runs on non-PR events.

nodes.name: Publish
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow trigger that publishes release artifacts to package repositories and winget when a GitHub release is published. Delegates to oxiguitar-packages/plugin-publish.yml with name=coreaudio, systems=macos. Requires PACKAGES_TOKEN and WINGET_TOKEN secrets.

nodes.name: Release
nodes.summary: Reusable workflow that test-builds the .oxp plugin on each system for PRs/develop/main pushes, and creates draft releases from v* tags containing zip, .deb, .rpm, Windows installer, macOS .pkg, and SHA256SUMS. Delegates to oxiguitar-packages/plugin-release.yml.

nodes.name: fingerprints.json
nodes.summary: Structural fingerprints of the project: content hashes, function signatures, class/method lists, imports, and exports for each file. Used to detect when files change and need re-analysis. Currently has structural analysis only for src/lib.rs and tests/contract.rs.

nodes.name: knowledge-graph.json
nodes.summary: The main knowledge graph containing nodes (23), edges (17), layers (4), and a 9-step guided tour. Captures the project's architecture: Core Plugin Layer, CI/CD Layer, Project Support, and Test Layer.

nodes.name: meta.json
nodes.summary: Metadata about the knowledge graph: schema version, generation timestamp, git commit hash, project root path, and statistics (23 nodes, 17 edges, 4 layers, 9 tour steps, 18 files analyzed across 6 languages).

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Version history following Keep a Changelog format and Semantic Versioning. Documents the unreleased section, v0.2.0 changes (plugin files as tar archives, unified test runner, knowledge graph analysis), and the initial v0.1.0 release.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude-specific working guidelines covering standing rules (no telemetry, no emojis, no signatures, library versions as published), branch workflow (develop/main), Rust version management (1.97 local / 1.99 MSRV), and repository conventions.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guidelines covering branch-and-pull-request workflow (develop as default, squash merges, ci-success required), test requirements for every feature, and Developer Certificate of Origin (DCO) sign-off process with bot exceptions.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust package manifest defining oxiguitar-audio-coreaudio-plugin v0.2.0 with Rust edition 2024 and MSRV 1.99. Dependencies: oxiguitar-plugin SDK (git rev), oxiguitar-audio-cpal (macos only, v0.2.0), cpal 0.18.2. Release profile with thin LTO and symbol stripping. GPL-3.0-or-later license.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview documenting the Core Audio output plugin for OxiGuitar, including install instructions, build steps (cargo test, build-oxp.sh, test-all.py), history, credits, and GPL-3.0-or-later license. Links to the manual and releases.

nodes.name: build-oxp.sh
nodes.summary: Build script that compiles the crate as a cdylib with the oxp feature for each macOS target (aarch64, x86_64), creates a universal binary with lipo, and packs it into a tar archive (audio-coreaudio-VERSION-macos-universal.oxp) with manifest.json first, then the library.

nodes.name: clippy.toml
nodes.summary: Clippy linter configuration: MSRV 1.99, allows unwrap/expect/panic/indexing/slicing in tests only.

nodes.name: deny.toml
nodes.summary: Cargo-deny configuration governing dependency graph analysis across six targets, security advisories, license compliance (allow-list for GPL-3.0, MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, etc.), banned crates, and allowed git sources (oxiguitar and oxiguitar-audio-cpal repositories).

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: OxiGuitar plugin manifest declaring interface version 1.3, plugin ID oxiguitar.audio-coreaudio, name 'Core Audio audio', version 0.2.0, macOS-only conditions, and the audio-device service coreaudio with priority 10.

nodes.name: rustfmt.toml
nodes.summary: Rust formatter configuration: edition 2024, max width 100, field init shorthand.

nodes.name: Core Audio output plugin
nodes.summary: Manual introduction explaining what the plugin does: hands OxiGuitar's sound to macOS Core Audio. Defines key concepts (latency, buffer), explains why each OS needs its own plugin, and links to use-cases.

nodes.name: SUMMARY.md
nodes.summary: mdBook table of contents defining the manual's structure: README, use-cases, architecture, requirements, install, features, testing, and credits pages.

nodes.name: credits.md
nodes.summary: Credits page listing all projects the plugin depends on: OxiGuitar plugin SDK, oxiguitar-audio-cpal, cpal, coreaudio-rs/objc2, Rust, and Core Audio. Also credits mdBook and cargo-deny as build tools.

nodes.name: features.md
nodes.summary: Features page listing all plugin features with their test names: Core Audio output offering, probing, device listing, error handling, macOS-only gating, and plugin file contract. Tests are prefixed with macos: for macOS-only tests.

nodes.name: how-it-works.md
nodes.summary: Architecture and strategy page: plugin built on cpal through oxiguitar-audio-cpal layer. Documents current limitations (unsigned .pkg, untested on real hardware), items left out on purpose (own sound library, recording), and areas where help is wanted (testing, lower latency).

nodes.name: install.md
nodes.summary: Installation guide: copying audio-coreaudio.oxp to the OxiGuitar plugins folder (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/OxiGuitar/plugins/), handling quarantine marks with xattr, and the .pkg installer.

nodes.name: requirements.md
nodes.summary: Requirements and assumptions: OxiGuitar 0.11 or later (plugin interface 1.4), macOS (Apple silicon or Intel). Assumes system sound works and the .pkg isn't signed/notarised.

nodes.name: testing.md
nodes.summary: Testing documentation for scripts/test-all.py: running all tests with one command, the three output files (summary.md, test-all.log, corpus-*.json), exit codes, failure reporting procedure, and command-line options (--release, --ignore-rust-version, --core, --out).

nodes.name: use-cases.md
nodes.summary: Usage guide: installing the plugin, picking output devices in the player bar, checking plugin status in Tools > Plugins menu. Explains that without an audio output plugin, OxiGuitar player buttons stay greyed out.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot configuration for weekly automated dependency updates on cargo and github-actions ecosystems. Ignores oxiguitar-* dependencies (pinned by git tag, interface 1.4 frozen). Targets the develop branch, limit 5 open PRs.

nodes.name: pull_request_template.md
nodes.summary: GitHub pull request template with sections for describing changes, testing instructions, and a checklist covering tests, docs, CHANGELOG, credits, corpus files, network use, and DCO sign-off.

nodes.name: book.toml
nodes.summary: mdBook configuration for the manual: title 'Core Audio output plugin manual', authors, source directory, GitHub repository URL, edit URL template, light/navy theme, no section labels, and search enabled.

nodes.name: apt-install.sh
nodes.summary: Robust apt package installer for CI: handles slow or unresponsive mirrors by watching download progress, rotating mirrors when apt stalls, and retrying up to APT_TRIES times. Never stops dpkg mid-install. Shared across all OxiGuitar repositories. Supports --recommends flag.

nodes.name: downloaded
nodes.summary: Shell function that calculates total bytes in apt's download folders using du -sb, used to detect whether apt is making progress.

nodes.name: watched_apt
nodes.summary: Shell function that runs apt-get in background while monitoring download progress. Returns 124 if downloads stall for STALL seconds, allowing the caller to retry with a different mirror.

nodes.name: rotate_mirrors
nodes.summary: Shell function that reorders apt mirrors by moving the best-priority mirror to the back of the list, using an inline Python script to parse and rewrite the mirrors file.

nodes.name: check-dco.sh
nodes.summary: DCO (Developer Certificate of Origin) sign-off checker. Iterates commits between two SHAs, skipping bot commits (Claude app, Dependabot) and verifying Signed-off-by trailers match author emails. Exits 0 if all signed, 1 if any missing.

nodes.name: test-all.py
nodes.summary: Unified test runner (Python 3.8+, standard library only) that runs every test of the repository: cargo test, extra stages from suite.json, plugin contract testing against the newest OxiGuitar core release, and features page validation. Outputs summary.md, test-all.log, and corpus JSON files. Shared across all OxiGuitar repositories. 1200+ lines with classes and functions for output, commands, cargo operations, corpus handling, and report generation.

nodes.name: Out
nodes.summary: Output class managing terminal display (with progress bar) and log file writing. Thread-safe with locks. Supports colored output, section headers, progress bars (terminal) or periodic lines (non-tty), and stamp formatting.

nodes.name: Cargo
nodes.summary: Cargo operations class: builds test binaries (--no-run), lists all tests, and runs them (--no-fail-fast). Parses cargo JSON messages to track compilation progress and binary metadata. Identifies test binaries and maps them to packages/targets/kinds.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point: parses CLI arguments (--corpus, --release, --ignore-rust-version, --core, --features-only, --out, --version), loads suite.json, sets up environment, runs all stages, and writes the summary report.

nodes.name: load_suite
nodes.summary: Loads tests/suite.json configuration, returning an empty dict if the file doesn't exist.

nodes.name: host_triple
nodes.summary: Returns the Rust host triple (e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) by parsing rustc -vV output. Cached after first call.

nodes.name: check_features
nodes.summary: Validates the features page: every feature names at least one test, and every test it names exists in cargo test output. Handles platform prefixes (macos:, linux:, windows:, x86_64:, aarch64:) and stage: references.

nodes.name: run_contract
nodes.summary: Runs the latest core's oxiguitar-plugin-test checker on each plugin file, optionally loading dependent plugins with --with. Streams output and reports failures.

nodes.name: prepare_core
nodes.summary: Prepares a checkout of the OxiGuitar core (newest release or --core DIR) with oxiguitar-cli and oxiguitar-plugin-test built. Caches fetched releases in OXIGUITAR_TEST_CACHE.

nodes.name: latest_core_tag
nodes.summary: Finds the newest published release tag of the core by querying GitHub API (or falling back to git ls-remote). Compares versions numerically.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Core plugin implementation: the Audio struct implements OxiGuitar's Plugin and Service traits, providing Core Audio playback through cpal's Core Audio host via oxiguitar-audio-cpal. macOS-only at runtime (cfg-gated), cross-platform build. Exports the plugin via export_plugin! macro. Contains unit tests for service offering, probing, device listing, error handling, and cross-platform availability.

nodes.name: Audio
nodes.summary: The plugin struct implementing Plugin and Service traits. Contains an optional CpalDevice field (cfg-gated for macos) that wraps cpal's Core Audio host. On non-macOS, probe returns Unavailable and call returns Unsupported.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Plugin initialization: creates a CpalDevice with Core Audio host on macOS; on other platforms the host parameter is discarded and an Audio with no device is returned.

nodes.name: service
nodes.summary: Service discovery: returns self as the Service implementation when queried for interface 'audio-device' with id 'coreaudio', None otherwise.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Probes Core Audio availability via the CpalDevice on macOS; returns Availability::Unavailable('it runs only on macos') on other platforms.

nodes.name: call
nodes.summary: Dispatches audio device method calls through the CpalDevice on macOS; returns Error::Unsupported('it runs only on macos') on other platforms.

nodes.name: it_offers_only_the_coreaudio_audio_device
nodes.summary: Unit test verifying the plugin offers only the coreaudio audio-device service and no other services.

nodes.name: probing_says_whether_there_is_an_output
nodes.summary: macOS-only unit test verifying that probing returns either Available or Unavailable with a non-empty reason.

nodes.name: listing_the_outputs_answers_with_or_without_a_device
nodes.summary: macOS-only unit test verifying that device listing returns either valid names or an error with a message.

nodes.name: wrong_requests_are_refused
nodes.summary: macOS-only unit test verifying that damaged requests return errors and unknown methods return NotFound, never crashes.

nodes.name: elsewhere_it_says_it_runs_only_on_macos
nodes.summary: Non-macOS unit test verifying that probe returns Unavailable and call returns Unsupported with the correct error kind.

nodes.name: contract.rs
nodes.summary: Contract test suite: builds the .oxp plugin file via oxiguitar_plugin_test::build and validates it through OxiGuitar's plugin host via oxiguitar_plugin_test::check. macOS-only (cfg-gated). Asserts all contract checks pass.

nodes.name: the_plugin_file_keeps_the_contract
nodes.summary: Contract test: builds the audio-coreaudio.oxp file and runs the full contract check suite, asserting all checks pass. Uses CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and CARGO_PKG_NAME for path resolution.

nodes.name: suite.json
nodes.summary: Test suite configuration: repository name, macOS-only gating, and plugin definition for audio-coreaudio (package name, library name, macOS OS restriction).
